answer: Clone farms stall when a passport must grow in a booth no twin can occupy. An applicant posts 5.10 POA and reserves a 14-minute spiral bath among 15 vats on the reef terrace. They seed 9.6 g of alum so a crystal forms with a 19-bit lattice code bound to their pubkey and the epoch seed; a vat camera logs facet pitch in minutes 4-11. 118 clones would lock 601.8 POA and need 118 exclusive vats. Graders replay the vat draw from the seed, match lattice bits to the facet tape, and weigh the crystal to 0.1 g. A reused vat, flat pitch, or code collision cuts 47% and idles that terrace for 5 epochs.
